title: Zesty Velvety Thai Meat Larb
description: A fermented and velvety monsoon Thai dish featuring gochugaru and beurre-monte, this dairy-free-friendly larb is a unique twist on traditional Thai cuisine. It combines the spicy and sour flavors of Thailand with the richness of beurre-monte.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the beurre-monte over medium heat until melted and smooth.
Add the ground pork to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks until it is no longer pink.
Add the gochugaru, fish sauce, lime juice, and rice vinegar to the pan, stirring to combine.
Add the Thai chilies to the pan, stirring to combine, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and cilantro.
Add the fermented soybeans to the pan, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the larb for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together and the larb has reached the desired consistency.
Serve the larb hot, garnished with additional scallions and cilantro if desired.
